lorenzo: Heads-up — onboarding magnet20k-int4 into staging showed a KV-cache divergence when we hit ~28k context during a long-shot summarization test. Repro steps + logs below.

ciara: Can you paste the minimal repro?

lorenzo: Yep. Ran the eval harness with the quantized checkpoint and streaming enabled. Command:
```
./run_eval --model magnet20k-int4 --prompt-file tests/long_summaries.txt --stream --kv-mode=shared --batch-size=1
```
Output snippet where it diverges:
```
[step 276] token=\"the\" logits_diff=0.0123 kv_index=28463
[step 277] token=\"country\" logits_diff=0.0001 kv_index=28464
[step 278] token=\".\" logits_diff=0.45 kv_index=1  <-- unexpected wrap
```
Looks like the KV index jumped back to 1 instead of moving to 28465.

ajay: That smells like a RoPE index wrap or an off-by-one in the ring buffer. Which rotary implementation are we using (legacy vs fused)?

lorenzo: Fused rotary (rotary_v2) with sparse-windowing enabled. Note: this only showed up under int4 quant config. FP16 baseline is clean.

sam: Any memory pressure or shard reallocation logs around that time?

lorenzo: Not in dmesg. But infra traces show a small GC cycle on the KV pager at 1764444449 (a couple ms before divergence). Pasted pager log:
```
KV_PAGER INFO evict_range start=28000 end=28300 at=1764444449
KV_PAGER INFO rebase_base new_base=1 old_base=28000
```
That rebase seems suspicious.

ciara: If rebase_base sets new_base=1, that would explain kv_index reset. Is rebase expected for long contexts? It normally shifts indices when we compact old prefixes. Might be a race with ongoing prefills.

ajay: Two hypotheses: 1) Compaction triggered while prefill strides were still inflight => pointer move without adjusting ring offsets. 2) Quantized kernel uses a cached view of kv_base that isn't atomic with pager updates.

sam: Can you repro with `--kv-disable-compaction`? Also try `--kv-stable-pin` flag if available.

lorenzo: Re-ran with `--kv-disable-compaction` and same input — divergence disappeared after 100 runs. With `--kv-stable-pin` also clean. So compaction race is likely.

ciara: Great repro. Next: replicate under CI with fuzzed timing to catch it in automated tests. Also add a guard in the fused rotary path to read kv_base atomically.

ajay: I can add a quick patch to the quantized kernel: load kv_base into a local before any index math and assert it's >= last_seen_index. If mismatch, we log and fallback to safe path. Will push a draft.

lorenzo: Please include a test case: long prompt ~30k tokens with an artificial slow prefill thread to force interleaving. I have a harness snippet:
```python
# test_long_compaction_race.py
client.run_async_prefill(prompt, delay_per_chunk=0.03)  # slow prefill
client.stream_generate(prompt)  # concurrently triggers compaction
assert not client.seen_kv_wrap()
```

qa-bot: @ciara scheduled a flaky CI job: eng-ml/kv-compaction-race-fuzz on 1764444510.

ciara: Thanks @qa-bot. Action items: ajay to open PR with atomic-read + assert + fallback (ETA EOD), sam to add CI fuzz job and `--kv-disable-compaction` flag shims in staging (ETA tomorrow), lorenzo to add harness and golden logs to the onboarding ticket.

sam: One more ask — capture a binary dump of kv_base + offsets at failure to speed root cause. Add `--kv-dump-on-assert=/tmp/dumps`.

lorenzo: Added dump flag and uploaded a sample to the ticket. Link: https://redwood-internal/issue/ML-ONB-4821#artifact.

ajay: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8342 — includes atomic read and fallback to scalar indexing for quant path. Tests added.

ciara: Reviewing now. If green, let's merge to staging and run the fuzz job for 24h.

lorenzo: Thanks all — great triage. I'm marking the onboarding ticket as blocked->in-progress. :thumbsup:
